_comment: Cross-platform parity contract. The WEB copies live in legislationpatch/util.js; the MOBILE copies live in legislationpatch-app/lib/format.ts. Both must produce these exact outputs. Run `npm run parity` in EITHER repo to check. Drift between the two hand-ported copies is what caused past date-ordering bugs — this fixture is the guard. When you intentionally change shared behavior, update both implementations AND this fixture together.
